acceptedProperties: The SDK has no stdin option; bounded control JSON is written to a root-owned 0700 directory and consumed by a fixed wrapper command.
Only a validated effect id enters the command string; program, wrapper, cwd, environment, timeout field, process id and auto-cleanup policy are fixed by the platform.
The wrapper loops to EOF, rejects non-root or group/world-writable control files, unlinks the control file before execution and drops to uid 10001 before touching the workspace.
Native process status and exit code are checked before bounded logs are decoded; killed, error, absent-after-fence and missing evidence cannot become completed.
A mismatched write acknowledgement cannot start a process, and the native adapter never retries writeFile or startProcess.
notAccepted: real Cloudflare Sandbox RPC writeFile ownership and startProcess integration

Tool Bridge RPC wiring from Trusted Pi Sandbox
